parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the stapler is made of ABS plastic, forming the main upper structure that houses the stapling mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the pressing force to drive staples through paper and holds the internal spring and staple track.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates downward around a hinge to press staples into the paper.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the stapler is a plastic cover that encloses the top portion of the body, providing a smooth surface and aesthetic finish.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the internal mechanism and provides a comfortable surface for pressing during stapling.
parts.Movement_description: It moves together with the body when pressed down and can be lifted for staple refilling.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the stapler is made of steel, providing structural support and stability during operation.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the paper and contains the anvil that bends the staple legs inward or outward.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the upper body moves; it may have a small rotating anvil plate for staple direction adjustment.
